title: Named complete supported skill package
summary: Validate a two-file supported package from a pinned GitHub tree while keeping uploads classified as snapshots.
why_it_works: Both supported files and known file modes are available in the pinned-tree test. The complete flag is expected only for that repository flow, never a folder upload. HTTP references are inert review signals, not proof of maliciousness.
mitigations: Verify all listed package files at a pinned commit.
Keep unsupported-file and missing-reference completeness checks enabled.
